name: Enthalpy v0.4.11
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.11

## Fixed

- Windows: Open from Sync → vault → passphrase → folder → Open workspace no
  longer lands on a dismiss-only "Sign in to the Sync account again" banner.
  If sign-in is needed, email and password are on that start screen.
- Linux x64 AppImage bundles libEGL.so.1 (and related graphics libraries) so
  it can actually launch a window.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
